content: Docker layer cache is sequential -- one invalidated layer (e.g., COPY of mix.exs/mix.lock changing, or an ARG/ENV like git SHA placed early) invalidates every layer after it; Elixir Docker builds should copy mix.exs/mix.lock and run mix deps.get/deps.compile before copying full source so dependency compilation is cached across app-code-only changes. Cross-arch (QEMU) CI builds can also see cache misses that don't reproduce locally.
